resources.string: Orange Box reads your car\'s OBD-II port through a Bluetooth ELM327 dongle and shows live data, trips and fault codes.

• Works fully offline; a server is optional.\n• Setup takes about a minute: accept the notice, allow permissions, add your car and pick your dongle.\n• You can skip the car and dongle and set them up later in Settings.

Never interact with the app while driving. Set it up while parked and keep your eyes on the road.

Readings come from your car's computer and a third-party adapter. They can be late, missing or wrong, and fuel figures are estimates. Don't rely on Orange Box for safety-critical decisions.

Clearing fault codes turns off the check-engine light but does not fix the fault behind it.
Grant what you need now; each permission can be changed later in Settings.
Fuel type and engine size improve the fuel estimate on cars without a mass-airflow sensor.
Pair the ELM327 dongle in Android\'s Bluetooth settings first, then pick it here and test it with the engine running.
You can change your car, dongle and permissions any time from Settings.
